request: Analyze GSE211204 for PMID 36071599 (Effects of short-term unloading and active recovery on human motor unit properties, neuromuscular junction transmission and transcriptomic profile.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Within-subject change in vastus lateralis gene expression across three time points in young healthy men: LS0 (baseline) -> LS10 (10 d unilateral lower-limb suspension, unloading) -> AR21 (21 d resistance-exercise active recovery). The exercise effect is AR21 vs LS10 (21 d of resistance training after unloading); LS10 vs LS0 is the unloading (inactivity) effect; AR21 vs LS0 tests return to baseline.
planned_contrasts: LS10 vs LS0 (S3.3.p1, Fig 4B; paper: 95 of 290 NMJ genes at q<0.05)
AR21 vs LS10 (S3.3.p1, Fig 4C; paper: 114 of 290 NMJ genes at q<0.05) - exercise contrast
AR21 vs LS0 (S3.3.p1, Fig 4D; paper: 24 of 290 NMJ genes at q<0.05)
final.repeated_measure_unit: participant (paired analysis adjusted for subject ID, S2.7.3.p1)
final.inclusion: 12 recruited; 1 dropped after baseline, 2 declined the AR21 biopsy (S3.p1) -> GEO has 11 subjects, 31 samples (11 baseline, 11 ULLS, 9 AR)
final.paper_method: RSEM counts -> edgeR filterByExpr (20,555 genes) -> voom with quantile normalization -> limma eBayes, adjusted for subject ID (paired) (S2.7.3.p1); DEG counts and volcanoes reported only for a pre-selected set of 290 NMJ genes (12 MSigDB v7.4 pathways, Data S1) and 33 ion-channel genes (S2.9.p1)
final.paper_results: NMJ genes q<0.05: LS10 vs LS0 95, AR21 vs LS10 114, AR21 vs LS0 24; leading-edge: COLQ down at LS10 / up at AR21; CHRNA1, CHRND up at LS10 / down at AR21 (S3.3.p2, Fig 5)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.3-S2.4 (ULLS, then 21-d resistance-exercise AR: leg press + leg extension 3x10 at 70% 1RM, 3x/week), S2.7.3.p1 (RNA-seq pipeline, limma-voom paired by subject), S2.9.p1 (DE reported within 290 NMJ + 33 ion-channel gene sets), S3.3.p1 (counts per pairwise contrast, q<0.05). DA.p1 names GSE211204.

checks: GEO: vastus lateralis, Homo sapiens, 31 samples; 11 subjects x baseline/ULLS/AR matches S3.p1 drop-outs (9 AR biopsies)
data_processing matches S2.7.3.p1 (Cutadapt, STAR 2.7.0f, RSEM 1.3.0, GENCODE v21)

ownership.reasoning: Accession, tissue, time points, sample count and processing chain all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns S1..S31 appear in brackets in the GEO title ('Subj_1 baseline [S1]'); exact match on that extracted key. subject and treatment come from the characteristics fields; treatment recoded to BL/ULLS/AR.

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: 'RSEM raw counts'; 87.5% integer values with fractional entries (RSEM expected counts), max 3.9e7, no negatives. Matches the paper's input (RSEM counts into edgeR/voom). Feature IDs 'ENSG|SYMBOL' re-keyed to symbols by prep_feature_ids.py (values unchanged).

design.subject: subject

candidates.value: pool ULLS and AR vs baseline
candidates.reason_rejected: paper compares the three time points pairwise; pooling mixes unloading and exercise
paper's analysis is paired on subject ID (S2.7.3.p1)

design.reasoning: One model with time (3 levels) and subject, the three pairwise contrasts the paper reports (Fig 4B-D). Exercise effect = AR vs ULLS. There is no non-exercising recovery arm, so AR vs ULLS cannot separate resistance training from spontaneous reloading after the suspension; recorded as a caveat.

covariance.reasoning: Repeated biopsies from the same 11 men; paper adjusts for subject ID. Subjects 4 and 5 lack AR and contribute only to BL/ULLS within-subject estimates. All samples are from one sequencing pool (2 lanes, GEO description), so no batch term.

final.method: limma-voom (R limma/edgeR via tools.r_de_tools, engine voom)

paper_route.method: edgeR filterByExpr + voom(normalize.method='quantile') + limma eBayes ~ subject + time
paper_route.reason: executor's voom path applies calcNormFactors (TMM) and does not expose voom's quantile normalization

deviations: TMM normalization instead of voom quantile normalization (executor limitation, tools/r_de.R:192,214)
DE reported transcriptome-wide; the paper reports counts only inside its 290-gene NMJ set (gene list in Data S1, not available here)

method.reasoning: Paper's own route is limma-voom on RSEM counts with filterByExpr and subject adjustment; the R voom executor reproduces it except for the normalization step.

final.deviation_note: Paper q<0.05 (also reports q<0.01, used here as the audit rule). Paper's q is reported within 290 NMJ genes; ours is BH over all filterByExpr-retained genes.

threshold.reasoning: S3.3.p1: 'differentially regulated at q < 0.05 (70 genes at q < 0.01)'; no fold-change cutoff.

caveats: Paper DEG counts (95/114/24) are within a 290-gene NMJ set whose list is not available; our transcriptome-wide counts are not directly comparable.
AR vs ULLS confounds resistance training with natural reloading/recovery after suspension (no non-exercise recovery control).
TMM instead of voom quantile normalization.

study.reasoning: Expected directions (S3.3.p2/Fig 5): COLQ down at LS10, up at AR21; CHRNA1/CHRND up at LS10, down at AR21.

discrepancies.item: gene universe of reported DEG counts
discrepancies.data: full RSEM matrix, 58,381 genes; NMJ list not deposited

executions.name: voom_paired
executions.reasoning: Paper's paired limma-voom: one model over all 31 samples, three pairwise time contrasts; AR vs ULLS is the exercise contrast.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper ran GSEA (custom NMJ sets, not reproducible); Hallmark GSEA on the exercise contrast as exploratory pathway context.
